title: Turn a rough brainstorm into a clean to-do list
facebook: Ever scribbled a brainstorm you couldn't read later? Here's a simple trick: paste your messy notes into any AI assistant and ask for a to-do list with who does what by when. No special tools needed — just copy, paste, done. https://aiworldhq.com/article/turn-a-rough-brainstorm-into-a-clean-to-do-list-with-any-ai-assistant
